Placemaker.LookoutHill.Name: Lookout hill
Placemaker.Recipe.LookoutHill.Descriptio: A big landscaped hill blended into the ground, a spiral or switchback path to a summit viewpoint; or a sledding hill, viewpoint mound, observation terraces or kite hill.
Placemaker.LookoutHill.subtype.Tooltip: Hilltop lookout, sledding hill (open run, straw bales), small viewpoint mound, stepped observation terraces or an open kite hill.
Placemaker.LookoutHill.height.Tooltip: Height of the summit above the original ground. A small area cannot hold a tall hill at a walkable slope; the summary says when it came out lower.
Placemaker.LookoutHill.shape.Tooltip: Mound: rounded foot and top. Cone: straight slopes. Dome: steep foot, round top. Mesa: broad flat top. Terraced: stepped levels.
Placemaker.LookoutHill.summitAt.Tooltip: Centre: the middle of the area. Far: away from the entrance (long slope towards it). Highest: on the highest existing ground.
Placemaker.LookoutHill.plateau.Tooltip: Radius of the flat top where the viewpoint plaza sits.
Placemaker.LookoutHill.maxSlope.Tooltip: Steepest slope of the hill. Near the outline it always blends gently back to the original ground.
Placemaker.LookoutHill.roughness.Tooltip: Natural bumps and hollows on the slopes.
Placemaker.LookoutHill.pathStyle.Tooltip: Spiral: winds round the hill at an even grade. Switchback: zig-zags up one side. Direct: straight up where it is gentle. None: no path.
Placemaker.LookoutHill.grade.Tooltip: How steeply the path climbs. 5 to 8 % is accessible, 12 % and more is a hiking trail.
Placemaker.LookoutHill.restSpots.Tooltip: Benches spread along the way up.
Placemaker.LookoutHill.viewpoint.Tooltip: What crowns the summit plaza: a lookout tower, a pavilion, a cairn or monument, just the plaza, or nothing.
Placemaker.LookoutHill.telescopes.Toolti: Coin telescopes on the summit rim, looking out.
Placemaker.LookoutHill.summitPaint.Toolt: Paints worn ground round the summit (permanent).
Placemaker.LookoutHill.treeDensity.Toolt: Trees on the slopes below the tree line.
Placemaker.LookoutHill.treeLine.Tooltip: Trees only grow below this share of the hill height, so the top stays open for the view.
Placemaker.LookoutHill.runWidth.Tooltip: Width of the open sledding run down the longest slope. Kept free of trees and paths.
Placemaker.LookoutHill.runOut.Tooltip: Straw bales (or a fence) across the bottom of the run.
Placemaker.LookoutHill.kites.Tooltip: Kites and windsocks on the open upper slopes.
Placemaker.LookoutHill.Issue.Lower: The hill reaches {0} m instead of {1} m: the area is too small for that height at this slope.
Placemaker.LookoutHill.Issue.PathShort: The path could not reach the summit at this grade; try a steeper grade or the switchback style.
Placemaker.LookoutHill.Issue.NoRun: No slope is long enough for a sledding run.
Placemaker.LookoutHill.Feature.viewpoint: Benches with telescopes and information boards on the summit rim.
Placemaker.AddOn.Viewpoint.Name: Viewpoint
Placemaker.AddOn.Viewpoint.telescope.Too: A coin telescope beside each bench.
Placemaker.AddOn.Viewpoint.board.Tooltip: A panorama / information board behind each bench.
